value.rationale: The exact unbounded noncactus no-four-cycle graph class is structurally natural: no four-cycle is equivalent to the unique common-neighbor obstruction and makes triangle boundaries edge-disjoint. The formula identifies the graph clique-core homotopy and exact integral extra spheres; each triangle changes first and second homology predictably. The C4 counterexample witnesses the sharp condition; exact noncactus examples motivate the new part beyond the high-girth and cactus special cases.
